title: South Cotabato school shooting deeply concerns DepED
summary: Cebu City, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) has expressed deep concern regarding a reported school shooting incident at Banga National High School in Barangay Banga, South Cotabato.…

blocks.text: Cebu City, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) has expressed deep concern regarding a reported school shooting incident at Banga National High School in Barangay Banga, South Cotabato. While videos of the incident have circulated on social media, authorities have yet to confirm details regarding casualties “Our immediate priority is the safety and well-being of our learners, teachers, and school personnel. We are closely coordinating with the Schools Division Office, Regional Office, local authorities, and law enforcement to verify the circumstances and provide necessary assistance,” DepEd said in a statement.
